text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 270 units of bivalirudin with a daily use of 8.8 units, providing 31 days on hand. Corvale General holds 137 units with a daily use of 10.7 units, providing 13 days on hand. The product label for NDC 55111065237 identifies Gland Pharma Limited as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) show a Voluntary Action Indicated classification from the most recent inspection ending 2024-07-25. Previous inspections of the same facility in 2012, 2015, 2017, 2019, and 2023 also resulted in VAI classifications. Bivalirudin is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list as of today.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses, but Corvale General has less than two weeks of supply. The manufacturing facility has a consistent history of VAI inspection outcomes. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Accord Healthcare, Inc., Avenacy, LLC, Civica, Inc., Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC to diversify supply sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and Gland Pharma inspection updates weekly; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to report procurement status and days-on-hand to P&T Committee at next scheduled meeting; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
